We go to the gym for our bodies. We work on our minds alone, in secret, like it’s something to hide. Oriaya is the gym where mental fitness is the workout, progress is the flex, and every small act is a way of rising into the creator of your own life.
Our story

Why I built Oriaya.

Stanford alum · ICF certified coach · years in corporate

I went to Stanford and spent years working in corporate roles. Later, I became an ICF certified coach. From the outside, my life looked steady. Inside, I was still learning to hear my own voice.

I remember two moments when I felt completely present. One was in Fairbanks, Alaska. I had a clear feeling that my life was truly worth living. Years later, I felt it again in a quiet cabin in Hope Valley, California.

Life changed after my kids were born. The years that followed were challenging. Some difficult relationships were psychologically exhausting. Over time, I began to see those experiences as a lens. They showed me another way to look at my life and at myself.

Coaching was transformational for me. It helped me find peace within myself. It also helped me step outward and become the creator of my own life.

That is why I built Oriaya. I want more people to have access to coaching and find their own way forward.

Why the name Oriaya?

We coined Oriaya from the Latin oriri, which means “to rise.” Ori means “my light” in Hebrew. In Yoruba, Ori refers to a person’s spiritual intuition and destiny, the inner self that guides them. Together, the name holds the idea of a light rising from within. It felt right for this work.

Questions, answered.

Is Oriaya therapy?

No. Oriaya is coaching for growth and forward motion, with clear scope and safety guardrails. Crisis resources are built in.

How does pricing work?

Mind Reps are free forever. No catch. Deep Sessions are $1.99 a month for on-demand guided AI coaching. 1:1 human coaching with Coach Jill is booked through her calendar — 45-minute sessions, online or in person in the Palo Alto area.

When does Oriaya Space open?

It’s our next chapter, not an open location yet. We’re testing demand through beta sessions in the Bay Area / Palo Alto area before committing to a permanent space. Join the waitlist to be first in the room.

Why might there be a no-show fee?

On-demand AI sessions never need a reservation. If you book a scheduled session with a human coach, a $10–$15 fee may apply only when someone reserves a spot and doesn’t show up or arrives very late. The idea is to protect the coach’s time and open the slot for someone else. It would be a fairness rule, never a profit mechanism.

Do I have to share anything?

Never. Sharing is 100% opt-in, and you decide exactly what leaves your private practice.

Who is it for?

For anyone living in this noisy era who still wants to hear their own voice. For the ones who are done merely surviving and ready to become the creator of their own life. If you're reaching for self-awareness and change, you belong here. Welcome home.
